// FIXTURE ONLY: the part of Hono and of the JWT reader the concept-db extract uses (a route table, fetch, c.req, c.json).
export type Context = {
  req: { json(): Promise<any>; header(name: string): string | undefined; method: string; path: string };
  json(body: unknown, status?: number): Response;
};
export class Hono {
  private routes = new Map<string, (c: Context) => Promise<Response> | Response>();
  post(path: string, handler: (c: Context) => Promise<Response> | Response): this {
    this.routes.set(`POST ${path}`, handler);
    return this;
  }
  async fetch(req: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const path = new URL(req.url).pathname;
    const handler = this.routes.get(`${req.method} ${path}`);
    if (!handler) return new Response('404 Not Found', { status: 404 });
    const c: Context = {
      req: { json: () => req.json(), header: (name) => req.headers.get(name) ?? undefined, method: req.method, path },
      json: (body, status = 200) => Response.json(body, { status }),
    };
    return handler(c);
  }
}
export function getJwtAuthFromContext(c: Context): { orgId: string; jwtToken: string } | null {
  const h = c.req.header('authorization');
  return h ? { orgId: 'org-fixture', jwtToken: h } : null;
}
